text: 【周末要闻汇总】1、国常会最新部署，有效扩大国内需求，核准四个核电项目；2、特朗普称同意取消对伊朗的打击；3、央行召开2026年下半年工作会议；4、市场监管总局开展光伏行业价格合规指导。
text_en: [Weekend News Roundup] 1. State Council executive meeting makes latest arrangements to effectively expand domestic demand, approving four nuclear power projects; 2. Trump says he agreed to cancel strikes on Iran; 3. PBOC holds H2 2026 work conference; 4. State Administration for Market Regulation conducts price compliance guidance for the photovoltaic industry.
